About

Curious by nature, systematic by trade.

Shahidur builds his work around a simple idea: pair genuine human judgment with the right AI tools and process, and both get sharper. Since 2018 he has moved across customer support, field-based market research, sales & marketing, and — more recently — AI prompt engineering and automation, picking up a practical, cross-functional skill set rather than staying in one lane.

That range shows up in how he works today: writing and refining prompts to get reliable output from AI tools, automating repetitive parts of research and reporting, planning outreach that actually reads an audience, and turning raw footage into clean, watchable short-form video. Each role along the way — including his time in customer support at Tech Point BPO — contributed a piece of that toolkit rather than defining it on its own.

He's a motivated, sincere professional who treats every problem as solvable with the right combination of patience, tools, and creativity — and who is always learning the next tool, technique, or workflow before it's asked for. He's looking for an organization where honesty, dedication, and a genuine growth mindset are valued, and where he can keep taking on more responsibility.

A public college in Noakhali Sadar founded on 1 March 1963 and affiliated with National University, on a roughly 21-acre campus donated by Chintaharan Chatterjee.

  • Location: New College Road, Maijdee Court, Noakhali
  • HSC classes began in 1963; honours-level study followed in 1991

Institution details
✓ Public information

One of the oldest schools in Bangladesh, founded in 1850 in Maijdee, Noakhali — over 175 years of continuous history, despite being relocated several times due to river erosion.

  • A boys' secondary school under the Comilla Education Board
  • Notable alumni include diplomats, a former army chief, and social activists
